system_thesis_interpretation: The full organism is an action-outcome life whose recurrent Dream transforms its own experience into persistent, connected memory; later goal-conditioned Think retrieves and composes that memory to improve action, which can yield more informative experience and continued improvement. This proposal does not instantiate that organism as a learning system. It is a single fixed-prompt, pre-context, external-text circuit: supplied factor-blind local permutations and public A are charged into Dream, a model-authored selected object is mechanically frozen/indexed, a bounded reader delivers a representation to Think, and Think alone can change the USE dispatched to a memory-blind actor. A complete pass can therefore establish tightly bounded causal plumbing for this exact resolver/prompt/harness on registered roots, not online learning, persistent parametric memory, compression, autonomous discovery, a learned controller, a life-level feedback loop, or the thesis's continued behavioral improvement.
graph_delta_interpretation: The added graph cleanly separates public-event delivery, content-addressed Dream staging, frozen corpus/index, target reader, target Think, public actor, and Think-local LOCK. The raw-A edge has unusually strong process attribution: paired h branches share the Dream-1 clone and treatment-invariant seed key, while G04 requires one charged raw-A read plus one charged pre-A parent read before a REPLACE PREDICT and a matching later COMMIT. The corpus-to-reader-to-Think-to-USE-to-actor path makes a direct corpus-to-actor shortcut auditable. It does not force the selected text to be semantic or force the later USE effect to be mediated by the h-specific revision: the action contrasts are selected h=0 corpus interventions, and the proposal correctly forbids an h-mediated-action claim. Exact handle/identifier and mutation tests reduce metadata shortcuts, but they cannot prove absence of every model prior, lexical convention, or harness-induced shortcut at the writer-reader interface.
loop_delta_interpretation: Temporal order is adequate for the narrow causal question: Dream-1 precedes raw A; a fresh Dream-2 receives raw A only after charge; selected bytes and permitted provenance freeze at Sleep T2; target-blind sham construction occurs after that freeze and before T3 target/query; then reader, Think, and actor are separate and evaluation never returns upstream. Thus a valid trace distinguishes prospective commitment, post-A selected-object change, and later action. It is nevertheless one short, fixed life with one prescribed revision opportunity and no later Dream caused by target action, no persistence beyond the constructed corpus, and no learned update. Recurrent Dream is compared only to eligibility/output-capacity-matched one-shot Dream; interaction and compute differ. Opaque Think has no one-shot, recurrence-removal comparator, so recurrence necessity, efficiency, and scale/lifetime-length effects remain unmeasured.
claim_delta_interpretation: The claimed positive is appropriately non-headline: on exact registered roots, supplied event-local permutations supported prospective commitments; a raw-A-conditioned paired branch selected byte-distinct replacement objects under mechanical receipt checks; and predeclared frozen-corpus interventions changed selected-h later USE behavior. G04 supports a syntactic/provenance-defined selected-object update, not semantic correctness, truth, content rewrite, or durable belief revision. G09-G11 can show an effect of the complete corpus-reader-Think-actor bundle relative to EMPTY, crossed-antipode, and target-blind sham controls on these cells, but cannot isolate Dream authoring from lexical reader conventions, prompt priors, or a standard agent using raw context/RAG/graph memory. The q construction is a descriptive specificity alarm, not a null-effect estimate, population test, or leakage proof. All calls are nested within a tiny exact-root construction; 3,414 opportunities are not 3,414 independent scientific units. No text-versus-LoRA fixed-memory transport comparison, compression frontier, online-learning evidence, or continued-improvement evidence is present.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility design is strongest at target time. TARGET_READER alone receives the assigned corpus/index and query; TARGET_THINK receives only public task data, a fixed handle, and its bounded reader result; PUBLIC_ACTOR receives only public state/menu, one validated USE, and sealed transition bytes, while LOCK is local. Target/source, treatment, identity, digest, path, length, cache, timing, score, and private truth are forbidden at the actor and are tested by deny-by-default injection and mutation. Dream visibility is also temporally constrained through charged reads and fixed-shape treatment-invariant identifiers. This validates interface noninterference conditional on complete implementation and side-channel fixtures; it is not proof that an opaque NOTE cannot carry a private code or that the fixed pretrained model has no relevant prior. Primary reporting's opaque-byte seal appropriately prevents semantic post hoc rescue but means the opaque lane cannot itself establish semantic-memory content.
acceptance_test_interpretation: T01 establishes finite factor/chord construction and exact target algebra, an executable construct ceiling rather than learned discovery. T02 establishes orbit, goal-twin, h-prefix, q-null, seed, and treatment-free identifier pairings; it reduces label/identity confounds but cannot neutralize model priors. T03 makes terminal sequences unique and sham timing target-blind. T04 fixes same-q matching and explicitly limits ANY_INDEPENDENT_SUCCESS and SPECIFICITY_CONCERN to descriptive alarms. T05 enforces chronology and the reader-Think-actor firewall, the key defense against target-only or actor-side corpus shortcuts. T06 validates typed chronology, caps, terminal semantics, and ordinal identity; T07 validates model-authored Dream objects and makes one-shot Dream only a qualified eligible-information/output-capacity comparison, not a fair recurrence or compute comparison. T08 tests deterministic projection invariance after causal freeze, not a stochastic counterfactual rerun. T09 preserves opaque/AST lane separation and prevents target-aware sham or opaque semantic rescue. T10 is the decisive process falsifier for the raw-A read-to-PREDICT-to-COMMIT REPLACE chain and paired selected-byte difference, but deliberately does not test h-to-action mediation. T11 limits target reading to bounded lexical NOTE/AST/NOT_FOUND and rejects an opaque oracle. T12 confines exact solvers and actor applications to a zero-model-call CPU ceiling; those are ceilings, not competing learned agents. T13 freezes the 910-plus-2,504 roster and correctly records omitted A-MEM, RAW_RAG, raw-context, class/neutral, and opaque one-shot-Think comparisons as absent rather than negative results. T14 makes all runtime/executable evidence future, post-ratification evidence and turns incompatibility into NOT_RUN. T15 prevents survivorship, receipt substitution, failure-mediated redirection, and conditional-pooling mistakes, while its strict all-gate rule makes Stage 2 selected on Stage-1 success. T16 verifies the exact 1,540/1,560 CPU and 3,414 scientific/3,416 process ceilings; capacity margins do not create evidence or sample size. T17 requires a fresh executable snapshot, independent review, advocate response, and separate pre-GPU approval, preserving the human boundary. T18 turns all G01-G11—including strict selected-h SELF contrasts—into a predeclared kill switch; a failure localizes this exact circuit and must not be read as a thesis falsifier. T19 keeps untouched/q rows conditional and failure-inclusive, reports q fields without inference, and terminates HUMAN_REQUIRED; conditional Stage 2 is neither replication nor a generalization sample.
assumptions: The proposal's static fixtures and later executable snapshot can faithfully enforce every declared allowlist, renderer, identifier, reset, and resource invariant before any scientific call.
The exact registered factors, target sequences, goal twins, and target-blind sham construction are representative only of the proposal's named roots, not of an external task distribution.
The lexical target reader and fixed prompts do not introduce an undeclared treatment-correlated channel beyond those caught by the prescribed side-channel and mutation suites.
An endpoint difference after the stated paired controls is interpreted only as a causal effect of the entire assigned corpus-reader-Think-actor bundle on selected terminal behavior.
A complete Stage-1 pass is a predeclared condition for spending Stage-2 budget, not evidence that makes the conditional Stage-2 cells independent confirmation.

ambiguities.question: Which current proposal bytes supersede bound advisories that identify their audited proposal by an earlier SHA-256 value?
ambiguities.impact: The change binds those advisories as context while their stated byte target is not the current proposal; they can inform concerns but cannot certify that every cited repair applies without an explicit current-byte disposition.

ambiguities.question: What exact estimand is intended for the strict selected-h SELF-minus-control gates: a circuit-survival criterion or an effect-size claim?
ambiguities.impact: The four paired endpoint differences can support only a registered descriptive circuit criterion; the proposal must not imply a population effect, precision estimate, or independent-call sample size.

ambiguities.question: How much of any opaque SELF effect is attributable to Dream authoring versus fixed prompt priors, supplied local permutation extraction, lexical retrieval, and target-menu structure?
ambiguities.impact: The named controls test corpus interventions but do not identify the contribution of Dream relative to standard raw-context, RAG, graph, reflection, or long-context agents.

ambiguities.question: Does a branch-distinct opaque selected object have any semantic relation to the public A beyond the required receipt and byte predicates?
ambiguities.impact: No semantic interpretation is valid for opaque success; the AST diagnostic cannot answer this for the opaque lane because it is non-rescuing and uses a different representation.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal should not be described as testing whether the full dream-memory-think organism is useful, except as a deliberately incomplete organ-survival assay.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The life is fixed and pre-context; Sleep is mechanical external storage/indexing; the model, prompts, and controller are fixed; there is no parameter update, memory-pressure regime, action-selected acquisition, later re-dream, or continued-improvement measurement.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Retain only the exact-root conditional DEV descriptor and require separately ratified post-native lifetime, retention, and action-feedback studies for organism-level claims.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: SELF versus EMPTY, crossed, and sham does not constitute a comparator suite for Dream or external-memory superiority.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The roster explicitly omits standard frozen/raw-context, truncated long-context, RAG, linked graph/A-MEM, reflection, direct-LoRA, batch-post-training, and resource-matched alternatives. Its controls establish local corpus intervention sensitivity, not which memory mechanism is responsible or best.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Report omitted comparators as NOT_RUN/non-comparative and reserve mechanism or superiority attribution for a separately designed fixed-budget comparator benchmark.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposed one-shot diagnostics cannot support a recurrence-removal or efficiency conclusion.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: One-shot Dream is only eligible-information/output-capacity matched and has different interaction/compute; only four structured AST one-shot Think rows exist, with no opaque Think counterpart. Scale and lifetime-length are also not manipulated.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep recurrence, efficiency, scaling, and lifetime claims retired; any such test needs a new, fully matched and independently powered proposal.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Conditional Stage 2 is a canary after a successful Stage-1 gate, not replication, confirmation, or independent evidence for Stage-1 contrasts.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Opening is deterministically selected by all eleven Stage-1 conditions, including the observed action contrasts; the cells share the same tiny constructed family and remain nested measurements.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Report Stage 1 and Stage 2 separately with the literal conditionality, and require untouched independently powered roots/lives in a later study for confirmation or generalization.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A quiet q alarm cannot validate specificity or rule out target-only and model-prior shortcuts.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: There are only two matched q constructions and the analysis contract correctly assigns no p-value, prevalence, or identification meaning. The q test is valuable as a falsifying alarm but has low coverage of possible shortcuts.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: State q only as the prescribed descriptive alarm and use richer held-out factors, raw-context controls, and independent roots before claiming specificity.

open_questions: Whether Rohin Ghosh ratifies these exact proposal bytes for only the declared scoped implementation and Stage-0 path.
Whether the post-ratification executable snapshot, realized fixtures, and fresh independent review establish every static gate without changing a scientific choice.
Whether a separate exact pre-GPU approval is granted after T17; this interpretation grants neither implementation nor execution authority.
Whether any later work will fund the missing fixed-budget comparators and post-native lifetime experiment rather than overinterpreting this DEV assay.
